sets.meaning: weapon types; six types: thermal, acoustic, radar, laser, jammer and point-defense

parameters.meaning: base probability weapon w of type c intercepts missile m if assigned
base conditional probability weapon w of type c destroys missile m if it intercepts
minimum and maximum range of weapon w of type c
1 if weapon type c can counter missile guidance type of missile m
maximum expected destruction/overkill-control threshold used in source constraint (14)
distance between weapon w of type c and missile m
setup time and time required for missile destruction in dynamic interval calculation
missile speed for dynamic coordinate updates

variables.meaning: 1 if weapon w of type c is assigned to missile m at the current stage
dynamic-stage version of assignment decision when the wrapper is active

objective.meaning: minimize weighted residual survival / wasted threat value; equivalent to maximizing missile destruction in the source

constraints.formula: sum_m x_cwm <= 1 for each non-jammer weapon
constraints.meaning: each weapon except jammer can be used against at most one missile at a time

constraints.formula: sum_c sum_w x_cwm >= 1 for each missile m
constraints.meaning: each missile receives at least one eligible defensive assignment when considered in the static stage

constraints.formula: assignment forbidden if distance is below minimum range
assignment forbidden if distance exceeds maximum range

constraints.meaning: jammer assignment requires missile within horizontal coverage
jammer assignment requires missile within vertical coverage

constraints.formula: x_cwm <= lambda_cm for c not point-defense type
constraints.meaning: weapon guidance-type compatibility, point defense can engage any type at close range

constraints.formula: source log product over assigned survival terms satisfies overkill-control threshold
constraints.meaning: prevents excessive assignment to a missile after sufficiently low survival probability
